subject: First meeting summary: performance constraints & trial plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex@acme.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@retailco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: First meeting follow-up: performance constraints & trial plan

Thanks Alex/Maria — good to meet today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key pain points (as we heard):
- Perceived chat latency is hurting conversion on mobile and in-store kiosks.
- Tail latency spikes during peak promo windows; customer has limited ability to fall back.
- Current infra requires manual sharding and adds operational overhead.

What we understand about current stack:
- RetailCo runs a mix of cloud-hosted inference + a small on-prem cache for frequently used prompts.
- Typical user messages are short (<= 64 tokens) but threads can grow to ~2–3k tokens.
- Peak concurrent sessions during promos: ~300–400 active chats; sustained concurrency ~120–150.

Target success criteria (for the trial):
- P95 end-to-end generation latency <= 250 ms for short completions (<= 64 tokens).
- Streaming first-byte latency < 200 ms for conversational streaming flows.
- Support for 350 peak concurrent streams (headroom to 500) with graceful degradation and automatic fallback.
- No material quality regression vs. current model; we will include 20 sample prompts for regression checks.

Immediate next steps (agreed):
1) Redwood to share a mutual action plan (MOP) and a recommended trial config (dedicated pool + autoscale guardrails). I attached our MOP template for you to fill with workload numbers.
2) RetailCo to share a small performance sample (CSV) with request size distribution and a list of 20 canonical prompts.
3) Schedule an engineering demo for the trial infra (we suggested Mon/Tue next week).
4) Redwood will provide a preliminary cost estimate for the trial and an Ops runbook for canarying.

Attachments: redwood_mop_template.xlsx (MOP template)

Open questions we flagged:
- Are there on-prem restrictions preventing streaming traffic from going through a Redwood Private control plane?
- Does RetailCo require HSM/KMS integration for trial keys?

I'll update the MOP with our baseline trial config (GPU type, estimated qps, and monitoring hooks) and send a follow-up that includes a proposed calendar.

Thanks — Sean

--

On Tue, May 5, 2026 at 3:12 PM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Alex/Maria — good to meet today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:
> 
> Key pain points (as we heard):
> - Perceived chat latency is hurting conversion on mobile and in-store kiosks.
> - Tail latency spikes during peak promo windows; customer has limited ability to fall back.
> - Current infra requires manual sharding and adds operational overhead.

Thanks Sean — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from RetailCo: 
- Our measured P95 for short generative replies is currently ~420 ms (client-to-client). We are aiming to get that under 300 ms to see an impact on conversion.
- During Black Friday style promos we see brief spikes to ~1.2s for a slice of traffic; those spikes mostly correlate with long context windows (3k tokens) and bursts of concurrent sessions.
- We do have an on-prem gateway that acts as a TLS terminator and enforces IP allowlists; outbound egress to cloud endpoints is allowed but goes through a proxy.

Attached is a small sample of our telemetry (retailco_perf_metrics.csv) with token lengths, timestamps, and percentiles for a week in April.

On trial success criteria we care about three things (priority order):
1) UX latency improvement (users feel the app is faster).
2) No regression on relevance for the 20 canonical prompts.
3) Predictable cost/ops during peak windows.

We can have our infra lead join the engineering demo — they prefer Wed/Thu next week in the afternoon (PST).

Thanks,
Maria

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: trial ops notes for RetailCo

Quick internal notes — copying Priyom for infra validation: 

- If outbound egress from RetailCo is via proxy we should confirm TLS fingerprinting and our control-plane connectivity. Priyom, can you validate whether Private control plane + on-prem gateway will be an option for trial?
- Suggested trial config: 2x A100-equivalent GPU nodes with automatic burst capacity to 4 nodes for promo windows; enable KV cache with 30m TTL for frequent prompts.
- Canary plan: start with 5% traffic redirected through Redwood Dedicated for 48 hours, monitor p95 and error rate, then 25% for 24 hours, then 100% if stable.

Action items for Sales: send the MOP + proposed calendar and ask RetailCo for the 20 canonical prompts + the telemetry CSV (we already received the CSV — thanks Maria). Also capture whether they require KMS/HSM for trial keys.

Thanks — Monica
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Subject: Mutual action plan & proposed trial start (RetailCo)

Maria — appreciate the quick reply and the sample metrics. Based on your signals we've put together a short mutual action plan below and proposed dates. Please reply with the preferred demo slot and confirm whether trial keys need HSM/KMS (yes/no).

Mutual action plan (high level)
- Week 0: MOP review + fill-in of workload numbers (RetailCo) — target by Mon 11 May.
- Week 1: Provision trial Dedicated pool; Redwood to run initial smoke tests (internal).
- Week 2: Canary run (5% -> 25% -> 100%) over a 7–10 day window; Redwood to provide dashboards and daily notes.

Trial deliverables (what we'll measure)
- P95 short-completion latency (<= 250 ms target).
- Streaming first-byte latency (< 200 ms).
- Quality regression report on 20 canonical prompts.
- Ops runbook and rollback playbook.

Proposed demo slots (PST):
- Wed 13 May, 2:00–3:00pm
- Thu 14 May, 3:30–4:30pm

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/RDC-2026-43 | DocuSign trial agreement: https://docusign.example/retailco-trial-2026
